# ClozFlow.ai

> Autonomous AI Sales Assistant & B2B Outreach Bot

ClozFlow.ai is an intelligent B2B sales automation platform. It deploys autonomous cognitive AI sales agents to find local leads, manage WhatsApp & cold email outreach campaigns, handle objections, and sync with CRMs.

## Core Features
- **Cognitive Agents**: 98% accuracy in intent detection with <200ms latency.
- **Outreach Studio**: Multi-channel campaigns via WhatsApp and Email.
- **Objection Handling**: Real-time contextual rebuttals.
- **CRM Syncing**: Native integration with Salesforce and HubSpot.

## Usage Data
